messages:
maria: Quick status — optkit delivery check. Can owners call out current blockers for quant recommendations + batching/caching integration? Need clarity before Friday canary.
aj: I can own quant recs v1, running final perf sweep on g5x this afternoon.
srinivas: batching integration has a small infra dep: need a config toggle in router to allow sub-batching. Filed infra ticket but waiting on eng-infra review.
maria: thanks. @aj can you post the perf numbers when done? want latency + p50/p95 and token cost delta.
aj: posting soon — preliminary: p50 up 8ms, p95 up 45ms for 2k seq, tokens/cost ~ -12% with int8.
olivia: re: caching — QA hit a regression in replay tests, saw duplicate KV keys leading to stale prefix hits. log: ```ERROR cache.lookup: duplicate key id=0x7f3a, evicting```
sam: that was from my change to prefix hashing. I'll revert and add a dedupe check. Working on a quick PR.
jen: Heads-up — deploy-bot reported a failed canary earlier today on dedicated cluster: 502s when backend fallback triggered. deploy-bot: CANARY failed (route: /v1/generate) — 502 x3 over 2m.
maria: do we have correlation between canary failures and batching toggle?
srinivas: possibly — the router falls back to synchronous path when it can't assemble a batch, and we saw a race where request context was closed early. Patching now.
aj: PR for quant recs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optkit/pull/482 — includes perf tables and quant config. Requesting review from @maria and @srinivas.
maria: ack, will review tonight. Priority: verify no regressions in prefix caching and router fallbacks.
olivia: QA will rerun replay after Sam's revert; ETA 3h. I'll post results.
sam: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/2110 — small revert + dedupe check, unit + integration tests added.
jen: Also flagging a dependency — dedicated cluster needs an updated CUDA runtime for the int8 kernels or fallback will be slow. infra ticket: INFRA-729.
srinivas: noted. If infra can't upgrade before Friday we should gate int8 rollout on hosted-only for the canary.
aj: agree. we can separate rollout by deployment tier.
maria: plan: (1) Sam to merge caching revert ASAP (2) AJ final perf post + CI green (3) Srinivas patch for router race merged (4) Infra decision on CUDA; if no upgrade, host-only int8 canary.
jen: booking a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT for final go/no-go. If any owner can't make, drop status here.
olivia: I'll be there.
sam: merging now, will ping when it goes in.
aj: perf job done, results uploaded to the PR artifacts. Summary: int8 improves cost but needs more p95 tuning for long seq.
maria: perfect. If any regression alerts pop up (quality or latency) tag #incidents and ping me.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-20T18:00Z (route /v1/generate) — will run hosted-only unless infra upgrades are applied.
maria: thanks — owners, please update your PRs with checklist items before EOD.
